svg.aria-label: MSTeams_Parser — Microsoft Teams DFIR Forensic Suite with LevelDB and IndexedDB Parsing

g.text: Reconstruct enterprise Teams chats, calls, meetings, & media.
Ingests New Teams (%LOCALAPPDATA% EBWebView) & Classic stores
Unpacks Base64 JSON cards, call durations, meeting logs, & roles
Resolves internal 8:orgid GUIDs to corporate employees & emails
Carves cached images while filtering UI telemetry noise (< 3.5 KB)
5-step pipeline • magic-byte carver • dual UTC/IST • HTML dossier
HTML DOSSIER • UTF-8 BOM CSVs • ZIP MEDIA
